wiki_catalogs.name: Project Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the Jev Chat Jarvis project overview section. Explain its purpose as an AI-powered conversation co-pilot for Android that analyzes chat messages and provides intelligent reply suggestions without automatically sending them. Document the core value proposition: privacy-first processing, multi-platform support (QQ, X/Twitter, Feishu/Lark, WeChat), local OCR capabilities, and knowledge base integration. Describe the target audience including professionals needing AI assistance in business communications, users seeking privacy-focused AI tools, and developers wanting to extend platform support. Include platform compatibility matrix, key differentiators from other AI chat assistants, and the project's architecture philosophy of reading screen content through accessibility services rather than hooking into apps.

wiki_catalogs.name: System Overview
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive system overview documentation for Jev Chat Jarvis architecture. Explain the high-level modular Android architecture with clear separation between presentation layer (Activities like MainActivity, SettingsActivity), service layer (ChatCaptureService for background processing), business logic layer (analysis pipeline and AI integration), data layer (KbStore for persistence), and integration layer (external API clients). Document the overall data flow from message capture through analysis to response generation. Include architectural diagrams showing component relationships and communication patterns. Explain the privacy-first design principles where OCR processing happens locally and sensitive chat data stays on device. Address system boundaries, security considerations around accessibility services, and performance optimization strategies.

wiki_catalogs.name: JevClient Architecture
wiki_catalogs.prompt: Create comprehensive content for the JevClient architecture component. Explain how JevClient serves as a thin facade over split clients (JudgeClient and ReplyClient) to provide a unified entry point for AI operations. Document the analysis lifecycle management using UUID-based analysisId for billing and tracking across multiple API calls. Detail the three main methods: judge() for intent recognition, draftAndRank() for two-stage reply generation pipeline, and analyze() for combined judgment with replies. Explain how configuration is read from Prefs for provider switching without client recreation. Include examples of usage patterns, error handling strategies, and performance considerations for sequential vs parallel processing.

Explain the window detection logic using rootInActiveWindow and package name matching. Cover the conversation session management with ConversationToken and target tracking. Document the debouncing mechanism for handling rapid UI updates and the worker thread pool for background processing. Include examples of accessibility node traversal and the disguised class technique used to bypass WeChat's anti-accessibility measures.

For the ChatAppAdapter interface, document the extract method signature, parameters including root accessibility node and resources, return value specifications for ChatSnapshot objects, and null handling for non-chat contexts. Detail the OcrEngine interface for custom OCR implementations including method signatures, image processing parameters, and text extraction results. Document the ChatModels data structures including Msg class with sender identification, ChatSnapshot representing conversation state, and Analysis results from AI processing. Include parameter descriptions, return value specifications, exception handling patterns, and usage examples for extending platform support. Address the internal API boundaries and recommended patterns for third-party integrations.

<blog>
# JEV Chat Jarvis - Comprehensive Project Analysis

## 1. Project Introduction

**JEV Chat Jarvis** is an AI-powered chat assistant for Android that provides intelligent analysis and reply suggestions for supported messaging applications. The project serves as a "conversation co-pilot" that reads messages from the screen using Android's accessibility services, analyzes them with AI models, and presents contextual response suggestions without ever automatically sending messages.

### Core Goals and Objectives
- **Intelligent Message Analysis**: Use AI to understand message intent, risk level, and appropriate response strategies
- **Multi-Platform Support**: Support for QQ, X/Twitter, Feishu/Lark, and WeChat through specialized adapters
- **Privacy-First Design**: All processing happens locally; only configured API endpoints receive data
- **User Control**: Users maintain full control over message sending; the app only fills input fields
- **Extensible Architecture**: Easy addition of new chat application support through adapter pattern

### Target Audience
- Users seeking AI assistance for professional and personal communications
- Teams requiring consistent communication patterns across multiple platforms
- Privacy-conscious users who want AI capabilities without compromising data security

## 2. Technical Architecture

The project follows a modular Android architecture with clear separation of concerns:

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[MainActivity] --> B[ChatCaptureService]
    B --> C[ChatAppAdapter Interface]
    C --> D[QQ Adapter]
    C --> E[X Adapter] 
    C --> F[Feishu Adapter]
    C --> G[WeChat Adapter]
    B --> H[OCR Engine]
    B --> I[JevClient]
    I --> J[JudgeClient]
    I --> K[ReplyClient]
    B --> L[OverlayController]
    B --> M[KbStore]
    M --> N[Knowledge Base]
    M --> O[Contact Database]
    M --> P[Chat History]
```

### Component Breakdown

**Core Layers:**
- **Presentation Layer**: MainActivity, SettingsActivity, KnowledgeActivity
- **Service Layer**: ChatCaptureService (accessibility service), KeepAliveService
- **Business Logic**: JevClient, ConversationSession, CaptureRules
- **Data Layer**: KbStore (knowledge base), Prefs (configuration)
- **Integration Layer**: OCR engines, external API clients

### Design Patterns
- **Adapter Pattern**: Per-app chat application adapters for message extraction
- **Observer Pattern**: Accessibility event handling for real-time monitoring
- **Strategy Pattern**: Multiple OCR engine implementations
- **Repository Pattern**: Centralized data access for knowledge base operations

## 3. Key Implementation

### Main Entry Points
- **MainActivity** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/MainActivity.kt`): Application entry point with setup wizard and permission management
- **ChatCaptureService** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/capture/ChatCaptureService.kt`): Core accessibility service handling message capture and analysis orchestration

### Core Modules
- **ChatAppAdapter** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/capture/ChatAppAdapter.kt`): Interface defining per-app message extraction logic
- **JevClient** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/jev/JevClient.kt`): Unified client for AI judgment and reply generation
- **KbStore** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/core/kb/KbStore.kt`): Local knowledge base storage for contacts, notes, and chat history

### Configuration Management
- **Prefs** (`app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/core/Prefs.kt`): Centralized configuration management for API keys, models, and user preferences
- **Build Configuration** (`app/build.gradle.kts`): Android build setup with ML Kit integration and signing configuration

### External Dependencies
- **ML Kit Text Recognition**: On-device Chinese OCR capabilities
- **Android Accessibility Services**: System-level UI interaction for reading chat interfaces
- **JSON Processing**: Built-in org.json for local data serialization

### Integration Points
- **API Endpoints**: Configurable judge/reply/vision model endpoints via Prefs class
- **System Services**: Android accessibility, overlay permissions, clipboard access
- **Storage**: App-private file system for knowledge base and settings

## 4. Key Features

### Intelligent Message Analysis
The core analysis pipeline processes incoming messages through multiple stages:

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant User
    participant Service as ChatCaptureService
    participant OCR as OCR Engine
    participant Judge as JudgeClient
    participant Reply as ReplyClient
    participant Overlay as OverlayController
    
    User->>Service: Open chat app
    Service->>Service: Extract messages via adapter
    alt No text available
        Service->>OCR: Screenshot + OCR
        OCR-->>Service: Recognized text
    end
    Service->>Judge: Analyze intent & risk
    Judge-->>Service: Judgment results
    Service->>Reply: Generate candidate replies
    Reply-->>Service: Ranked responses
    Service->>Overlay: Display analysis panel
```

### Multi-Platform Chat Support
- **QQ Integration**: Direct node access with avatar-based sender detection
- **X/Twitter Support**: Compose UI parsing with contentDescription extraction
- **Feishu/Lark Handling**: Hybrid approach combining bubble rectangles with OCR
- **WeChat Compatibility**: Disguised accessibility service for obfuscated UI trees

### Knowledge Base System
```mermaid
erDiagram
    CONTACT ||--o{ CHAT_HISTORY : has
    NOTE ||--o{ TAGS : contains
    CONTACT ||--o{ NOTES : references
    
    CONTACT {
        string id
        string name
        array aliases
        array apps
        string relationship
        string notes
    }
    
    CHAT_HISTORY {
        string side
        string text
        long timestamp
        string app
    }
    
    NOTE {
        string id
        string title
        string content
        array tags
        boolean alwaysOn
    }
```

### OCR and Screen Capture
- **Adaptive OCR Strategy**: Chooses between targeted bubble OCR and full-screen recognition based on available UI information
- **Performance Optimization**: Debouncing, throttling, and failure backoff mechanisms prevent excessive screenshot attempts
- **Privacy Protection**: All OCR processing occurs locally on device; no screenshots are uploaded

### User Interface Components
- **Floating Overlay Panel**: Non-intrusive analysis display with real-time updates
- **Permission Management**: Guided setup process for accessibility and overlay permissions
- **Settings Interface**: Comprehensive configuration for API endpoints, models, and behavior options

## 5. Conclusion and Recommendations

### Project Architecture Strengths
- **Modular Design**: Clear separation between platform-specific adapters and core business logic
- **Privacy-First Approach**: Local processing with configurable external API endpoints
- **Extensible Architecture**: Easy addition of new chat applications through adapter pattern
- **Robust Error Handling**: Comprehensive fallback mechanisms for OCR and network failures

### Potential Improvement Areas
- **Testing Coverage**: Expand unit test coverage for critical business logic paths
- **Documentation**: Add inline code documentation for complex adapter implementations
- **Performance Monitoring**: Implement metrics collection for OCR accuracy and API response times
- **Configuration Validation**: Add schema validation for API endpoint configurations

### Recommended Next Steps
1. **Enhanced Testing**: Create comprehensive test suites for OCR accuracy and multi-platform compatibility
2. **Performance Optimization**: Profile memory usage during extended sessions and optimize bitmap handling
3. **Feature Expansion**: Add support for additional messaging platforms following existing adapter patterns
4. **Analytics Integration**: Implement privacy-respecting usage analytics to improve OCR accuracy and adapter performance

### Sources

- [MainActivity.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/MainActivity.kt)
- [ChatCaptureService.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/capture/ChatCaptureService.kt)
- [ChatAppAdapter.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/capture/ChatAppAdapter.kt)
- [Prefs.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/core/Prefs.kt)
- [JevClient.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/jev/JevClient.kt)
- [KbStore.kt](app/src/main/java/com/jev/probe/core/kb/KbStore.kt)
- [build.gradle.kts](app/build.gradle.kts)

</blog>
